description: Angular component for configuring map layer settings in a widget, including form handling, provider selection, and validation logic.

classes.name: MapLayerSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing map layer settings, including form initialization, provider change handling, and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form, patches initial values, subscribes to provider changes, and updates validators.

methods.name: labelPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the placeholder label text, translated.

methods.name: applyLayerSettings
methods.description: Emits the current form values as layer settings.

methods.name: onProviderChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in map provider, updating form values accordingly.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the selected provider.
